stories.story_fr: Toutes les trois régions sont en territoire positif pour la première fois en 11 trimestres.
stories.story_en: All three geographies are in positive territory for the first time in 11 quarters.
stories.quote: All three geographies in positive territory for the first time in 11 quarters

stories.story_fr: L’Amérique du Nord est le principal moteur de croissance, avec une progression à deux chiffres du carnet de commandes.
stories.story_en: North America is the main growth engine, with double‑digit backlog progression providing visibility.
stories.quote: North America on a solid growth trajectory, with double‑digit backlog progression providing visibility into the year

stories.story_fr: L’Europe poursuit sa reprise progressive grâce à un rebond de l’électrification malgré la crise au Moyen‑Orient.
stories.story_en: Europe continues its progressive recovery with an electrification rebound despite the Middle East crisis.
stories.quote: Europe continuing its progressive recovery, with electrification rebound providing a potential additional tailwind against the backdrop of the Middle East crisis

stories.story_fr: Le taux de pénétration digitale augmente de 217 points de base pour atteindre 36 % des ventes.
stories.story_en: Digital penetration rate ramps up by 217 basis points to 36 % of sales.
stories.quote: Continued ramp‑up of digital penetration rate, up +217bps to 36% of sales in Q1 2026

stories.story_fr: Les prévisions 2026 sont confirmées : croissance des ventes same‑day de 3 % à 5 %, marge EBITA ajustée à 6,2 % et conversion du flux de trésorerie disponible supérieure à 65 %.
stories.story_en: 2026 outlook confirmed: same‑day sales growth of 3 %‑5 %, adjusted EBITA margin at c. 6.2 % and free cash flow conversion above 65 %.
stories.quote: 2026 outlook confirmed: 3% to 5% same‑day sales growth, current adjusted EBITA margin at c. 6.2% and free cash flow conversion above 65%
